name: The Lost Runner

angles.text: As a night elf, you know safe messages from the ancient Oracle Tree guide the kaldorei leadership in Darnassus.
As an Alliance member, you know safe roads and clear communication across Teldrassil help keep Darnassus and Alliance territory stable.

faq.answer: Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow is the missing runner, a night elf sentinel still in training. She was sent to carry a message from the Oracle Tree to Darnassus.
The Oracle Tree is an ancient tree in the Oracle Glade that periodically sends messages to the night elf elders in Darnassus. Sentinels stationed there carry those messages safely.
Eralya was expected on the westward road between Darnassus and the Oracle Glade. Runners use that road to carry messages from the tree.

aliases: who sent sentinels to oracle tree
what is council of the forest
faq.answer: The Council of the Forest stationed a detachment of Sentinels at the Oracle Tree. They carry its messages safely and swiftly to the elders in Darnassus.
faq.q: Who stationed the Sentinels at the Oracle Tree?

aliases: how often does oracle send messages
faq.answer: Messages from the Oracle Tree arrive at irregular intervals, but Eralya's absence has lasted unusually long. Her superiors are concerned because she is still a trainee.
faq.q: Why is her absence a concern?

aliases: what do you do in the lost runner
faq.answer: You are asked to search west along the road toward the Oracle Glade for Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow and learn what delayed her.
faq.q: What is the objective of this search?

sections.body: The Council of the Forest keeps Sentinels at the Oracle Tree in Teldrassil. The ancient tree sends sacred messages to the night elf elders, and runners carry them along the forest roads to Darnassus. Their safe arrival guides the kaldorei and helps govern them.
sections.title: Messengers of the Oracle

sections.body: Silence from the Oracle Tree has lasted unusually long, and a courier has not arrived. Sentinel Eralya Leafshadow, an initiate still in training, was the latest runner sent out. Her superiors fear she has met misfortune on the trail, so they direct travelers west toward the Oracle Glade to search for her.
sections.title: An Overdue Courier

summary: In Teldrassil, a courier from the Oracle Tree is overdue on the road to Darnassus. The elders rely on its messages for guidance.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Lost Runner
